messages.text: I'm in Germany. If I order a Bitaxe from you will it come with an EU plug? And what about customs?
Searched the catalog · Bitaxe miner EU
Searched the catalog · Bitaxe Gamma desktop miner

Yes — the BSB Bitaxe Gamma 602 ($79) is sold in a US/EU/UK plug version, so a German order gets the EU plug and voltage. One catch: every Bitaxe variant, EU included, is showing out of stock right now.

On customs, I won't guess. Duties and VAT into Germany depend on how the shipment is declared, and I'd rather confirm the exact handling than quote you a number I'm not sure of.

Want me to check what's in stock for EU delivery in that price range?
